entities.name: ArgJ-like protein
observations: 489-aa sequence; best reviewed Swiss-Prot match is ArgJ from Caulobacter vibrioides (71.8% identity; 81.8% query coverage; E=6.53e-204).
Homology supports bifunctional arginine-biosynthesis enzyme activities: glutamate N-acetyltransferase and acetylornithine:glutamate N-acetyltransferase; inferred localization is cytoplasm.

entities.name: L-arginine biosynthesis
observations: ArgJ homolog annotations place this protein in cyclic L-arginine biosynthesis, including formation of N-acetylglutamate and ornithine.
